scope: Studio bottom HUD to native UE
behavior: Click numbered or Q/E/T/G slot to configure in an anchored five-column icon palette
Only owned skills, granted auras and owned consumables are available
Opening and assigning do not pause combat or activate an aura
Enabled state, name, count and saved UICreator edge motion are shown on quick slots
Reselecting the same aura preserves activation; moving it clears the previous slot
Clearing removes an assignment without deleting the owned item
Escape, outside click and shortcuts dismiss the picker; arrows navigate the native buttons
Unavailable equipment-granted auras are revoked together with mana reservation
Hover uses an authored tooltip with catalogue description and ownership source
compatibilityFixes: Load the new saved UI document and motion assets through the existing native template loader
Keep Q/E/T/G indices fixed across assignment, clear, depletion, ground drop and save/reload
Restore enabled aura contributions after a hotbar profile edit rebuilds the native loadout
